themes.name: Robot Datacenter
themes.description: A raised-floor datacenter staffed by six friendly robots. Each has a charging home; Atlas coordinates from a wall of monitors.
themes.author: William Pyle

themes.name: Orbital Station
themes.description: A quiet orbital outpost. Little robots service consoles, explore the deck and recharge between tasks.
themes.author: William Pyle

themes.name: Smurfs
themes.description: A cheerful Smurf village with Papa coordinating, Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey, Hefty and reusable Smurfs. Mushroom homes, smurfberries, a well, woodland work areas and a flowing stream.
themes.author: William Pyle

themes.name: Mooseville
themes.description: The original hand-painted village. Moose residents craft, explore, garden and rest as your agents work.
themes.author: William Pyle
